attributes.action: Give Local Taxpayers a Vote on County of Sanctuary Status
attributes.additional_details:
We call on the Government to give local taxpayers and residents the right to clear, factual information and the opportunity to vote before their county becomes or remains a County of Sanctuary.

Councils and City of Sanctuary UK trustees should provide full transparency on costs, funding, commitments, decision-making processes and local impacts, allowing residents to make an informed choice.

No accreditation without informed local consent and a public vote.
attributes.background: Give local taxpayers and residents the right to vote on whether their county becomes or remains a County of Sanctuary, ensuring decisions affecting local communities, services and public resources are subject to local democratic consent.

rejection.details: This is a matter for the local authorities concerned.
